ring.scope: Actual unmodified native execution. Every read has the correct sequential generation, including repeated neutral values. This proves causality beyond matching SID register values.

budget.scope: Unmodified automatic-activation PRG. Every NMI/boundary, exact buffer length and126cycle latch clock checked. RLE fills meet the actual NMI shadow-read deadline; no foreground wait/pointer-swap gate. Costs include hardware entry/RTI and JSR/RTS as stated; final nonreturning NMI is excluded from averages. Ring generations and audio quality require separate proofs.
budget.c3_background_control_scope: Includes active queue/boundary guards and branches between consecutive C3 calls. RLE fills and intervening idle waits excluded; final exit into each idle wait is not charged.
